lines.speaker: TY
lines.raw: [straining] A wall of bills! A conveyor belt of debt! And a coin avalanche right on top of—
lines.text: A wall of bills! A conveyor belt of debt! And a coin avalanche right on top of—

lines.speaker: TY
lines.raw: [shouts] MIA! Grab my hand!
lines.text: MIA! Grab my hand!

lines.speaker: MIA
lines.raw: [coughing, then quietly] ...Thanks. [pause] Don't tell anyone I said that.
lines.text: ...Thanks. Don't tell anyone I said that.

lines.speaker: TY
lines.raw: [fast, panicked] And then... the Thirty Percent Guy's interns showed up. Hundreds of tiny Thirty Percent Guys!
lines.text: And then... the Thirty Percent Guy's interns showed up. Hundreds of tiny Thirty Percent Guys!

lines.speaker: THIRTY
lines.raw: [tiny, many voices, chaotic] Fee! Fee! Fee! Fee! Fee!
lines.text: Fee! Fee! Fee! Fee! Fee!

lines.speaker: PICKLE
lines.raw: [panicked] They're taking thirty percent of my SOCK!
lines.text: They're taking thirty percent of my SOCK!

lines.speaker: TY
lines.raw: [awed] At the very top... the Robux Printer. [pause] And guarding it...
lines.text: At the very top... the Robux Printer. And guarding it...

lines.speaker: THIRTY
lines.raw: [giant, booming] Every coin! Every trade! Every SANDWICH! Thirty percent belongs to ME!
lines.text: Every coin! Every trade! Every SANDWICH! Thirty percent belongs to ME!

lines.speaker: TY
lines.raw: [scared] He's too big! We can't beat him!
lines.text: He's too big! We can't beat him!

lines.speaker: PICKLE
lines.raw: [suddenly brave] Wait. [pause] I have an idea.
lines.text: Wait. I have an idea.

lines.speaker: PICKLE
lines.raw: Hey, Mister Thirty. I want to buy something. [pause] For twelve Robux.
lines.text: Hey, Mister Thirty. I want to buy something. For twelve Robux.

lines.speaker: THIRTY
lines.raw: [greedy, booming] A purchase?! Marketplace fee! Thirty percent of twelve is...
lines.text: A purchase?! Marketplace fee! Thirty percent of twelve is...

lines.speaker: THIRTY
lines.raw: [calculating, slowing down] Three... point... six.
lines.text: Three... point... six.

lines.speaker: THIRTY
lines.raw: [panicking] Three point SIX?! But Robux don't have DECIMALS!
lines.text: Three point SIX?! But Robux don't have DECIMALS!

lines.speaker: THIRTY
lines.raw: [glitching, robotic stutter] Does not compute... does not COMPUTE!
lines.text: Does not compute... does not COMPUTE!

lines.speaker: TY
lines.raw: [laughing, disbelief] Pickle... you beat him with MATH!
lines.text: Pickle... you beat him with MATH!

lines.speaker: PICKLE
lines.raw: [proud] I never skipped math class.
lines.text: I never skipped math class.

lines.speaker: MIA
lines.raw: [snorts] Burn.
lines.text: Burn.

lines.speaker: SYSTEM
lines.raw: [calm, serious] Reset economy? [pause] All Robux will turn back into game currency. [pause] Your three million Robux will become... just Robux.
lines.text: Reset economy? All Robux will turn back into game currency. Your three million Robux will become... just Robux.

lines.speaker: TY
lines.raw: [hesitating, soft] Three million...
lines.text: Three million...

lines.speaker: TY
lines.raw: [reflective] I thought about the mansion. The gold toothbrush. The hundred friends who vanished as soon as the money did.
lines.text: I thought about the mansion. The gold toothbrush. The hundred friends who vanished as soon as the money did.

lines.speaker: TY
lines.raw: [pause] And then I looked at the two people who stayed.
lines.text: And then I looked at the two people who stayed.

lines.speaker: TY
lines.raw: [soft] The friend who waited outside my party in one shoe. [pause] And the sister who came back for me in the rain.
lines.text: The friend who waited outside my party in one shoe. And the sister who came back for me in the rain.

lines.speaker: PICKLE
lines.raw: [encouraging] Whatever you pick, Ty... I'll still share my umbrella with you.
lines.text: Whatever you pick, Ty... I'll still share my umbrella with you.

lines.speaker: MIA
lines.raw: [softer than usual] ...Yeah. Me too. [pause] Don't make it weird.
lines.text: ...Yeah. Me too. Don't make it weird.

lines.speaker: TY
lines.raw: [determined, shouts] RESET!
lines.text: RESET!

lines.speaker: TY
lines.raw: [warm] The next morning, everything was normal again.
lines.text: The next morning, everything was normal again.

lines.speaker: ANCHOR
lines.raw: [cheerful] Good news, everyone! Robux are once again just a fun game currency. And bread is back to two dollars!
lines.text: Good news, everyone! Robux are once again just a fun game currency. And bread is back to two dollars!

lines.speaker: TY
lines.raw: Dad got paid in real dollars. Mom used her coupons. And Grandma changed her password. [pause] For real this time.
lines.text: Dad got paid in real dollars. Mom used her coupons. And Grandma changed her password. For real this time.

lines.speaker: DAD
lines.raw: [joyful, sipping] The coffee machine is FREE again!
lines.text: The coffee machine is FREE again!

lines.speaker: TY
lines.raw: And Grandma's stream still gets two million viewers. [pause] She does charity streams now.
lines.text: And Grandma's stream still gets two million viewers. She does charity streams now.

lines.speaker: GRANDMA
lines.raw: [proud] It's "password three"!
lines.text: It's "password three"!

lines.speaker: TY
lines.raw: [sighs] ...We're working on it.
lines.text: ...We're working on it.

lines.speaker: MIA
lines.raw: [content] And my four hundred and twelve hats are worth exactly nothing again. [pause] I've never been happier.
lines.text: And my four hundred and twelve hats are worth exactly nothing again. I've never been happier.

lines.speaker: TY
lines.raw: And me? [pause] I'm broke again. [laughs] Totally, completely broke.
lines.text: And me? I'm broke again. Totally, completely broke.

lines.speaker: PICKLE
lines.raw: [warm] Here. One Robux. For your next mansion.
lines.text: Here. One Robux. For your next mansion.

lines.speaker: TY
lines.raw: [touched] ...Thanks, Pickle. [pause] I'm spending it on a shoe. For you.
lines.text: ...Thanks, Pickle. I'm spending it on a shoe. For you.

lines.speaker: PICKLE
lines.raw: [gasps happily] A SHOE?!
lines.text: A SHOE?!

lines.speaker: MIA
lines.raw: [grudging] For the record... you were a pretty okay millionaire. [pause] For like a day.
lines.text: For the record... you were a pretty okay millionaire. For like a day.

lines.speaker: TY
lines.raw: [smiling] Thanks, Mia.
lines.text: Thanks, Mia.

lines.speaker: ANCHOR
lines.raw: [breaking news] This just in! Starting tomorrow... EVERY video game coin becomes real money!
lines.text: This just in! Starting tomorrow... EVERY video game coin becomes real money!

lines.speaker: PICKLE
lines.raw: [excited] I have twelve of those too!
lines.text: I have twelve of those too!

lines.speaker: TY
lines.raw: [deadpan, to camera] ...Oh no.
lines.text: ...Oh no.

lines.speaker: TY
lines.raw: [to camera, upbeat] So... what would YOU buy if Robux became real money? Tell me in the comments!
lines.text: So... what would YOU buy if Robux became real money? Tell me in the comments!

lines.speaker: TY
lines.raw: And remember: never share your password. [pause] Not even "password three."
lines.text: And remember: never share your password. Not even "password three."
